Who we are

Every parcel carries more than goods.

VIDIRA XPRESS is an emerging courier and logistics company based in Andhra Pradesh. We connect people and businesses through delivery services built around care, clear communication, and dependable support.

Customer firstHelpful service and practical solutions.
Secure handlingCare and accountability at each handoff.
Fair valueAffordable solutions with transparent pricing.
People matterRespect for customers, teams, and partners.

Our Mission

To build India's most reliable, affordable and customer-focused courier and logistics network by providing efficient, organized and dependable delivery solutions for individuals, businesses and e-commerce sellers. We are committed to delivering exceptional service while making logistics accessible, simple and cost-effective for everyone.

Our Vision

To become one of India's most trusted courier and logistics brands by delivering innovative, reliable and affordable logistics solutions that empower businesses and simplify everyday deliveries. We envision a future where every customer experiences seamless logistics backed by technology, professionalism and exceptional service.

Frequently asked

Good to know.

For a quote or a route-specific question, contact our team directly.

How do I request a pickup?

Use the Get in Touch form to tell us about your shipment and collection and delivery locations. Our team will follow up.

Can businesses send regular or bulk shipments?

Yes. We support e-commerce, B2B, B2C, corporate, and bulk shipping needs. Tell us about your volume so we can discuss a suitable solution.

How can I become a delivery partner?

Complete the delivery executive application. The process includes verification, document submission, training, and approval before your first delivery.

Where is VIDIRA XPRESS currently based?

Our current office presence is in Vijayawada and Prakasam District, Andhra Pradesh. Contact us to check service coverage for your destination.
